title: The hardest startup roles to fill
summary: Forward deployed engineers are the hardest startup role to fill on Contrario, rated Hard every time and taking a median 92 days to hire. See how AI/ML, full-stack, DevOps and other roles compare.
body_markdown:
Every role on Contrario gets a hiring difficulty score, and every hire leaves a trail: how long the search ran, how many candidates recruiters put forward, and how fast the company moved once the right person showed up. Put together, they show which roles startups struggle with most, and where the time actually goes.


We looked at roles posted on Contrario between May 2025 and October 21, 2026. Most came from early-stage teams: 72% of engineering roles were posted by Seed or Series A companies.
